section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Suspension
title: Lower Arm

content.description: Illustration showing knuckle arm connection to shock absorber with bolts

items.main: DISCONNECT KNUCKLE ARM FROM SHOCK ABSORBER
substeps: (a) Remove two bolts holding the knuckle arm to the shock absorber.
(b) Push the lower arm down, and disconnect the shock absorber from the knuckle arm.

content.description: Illustration showing knuckle arm connection to tie rod with SST tool

items.main: DISCONNECT KNUCKLE ARM FROM TIE ROD
substeps: (a) Remove the cotter pin and nut holding the knuckle arm to the tie rod.
(b) Using SST, disconnect the knuckle arm from the tie rod.

content.description: Illustration showing stabilizer bar and strut bar connection to lower arm with nuts

items.main: DISCONNECT STABILIZER BAR AND STRUT BAR FROM LOWER ARM
substeps: (a) Remove the nut holding the stabilizer bar to the lower arm and disconnect the stabilizer bar.
(b) Remove the nuts holding the strut bar to the lower arm and disconnect the strut bar.

content.description: Illustration showing lower arm bolt connection to crossmember and rack boot protector

items.main: REMOVE LOWER ARM AND RACK BOOT PROTECTOR
substeps: Remove the bolt holding the lower arm to the crossmember and remove the lower arm with the rack boot protector.

content.description: Illustration showing press tool being used to disconnect knuckle arm from lower arm ball joint

items.main: DISCONNECT KNUCKLE ARM FROM LOWER ARM
substeps: (a) Remove the cotter pin and nut holding the knuckle arm to the ball joint.
(b) Using a press, disconnect the knuckle arm from the lower arm.
